title: 2.8 Uses of Microorganisms
description: Food, industrial, medical and environmental applications of microbes. Easy level, 20 questions.

questions.question: What is Fermentation?
options: Protein produced from cultured microbes for food or feed

Microbial metabolism used to produce foods and chemicals
